title: GAUGE: Group-Wise View-Inconsistency Rectification for Feed-Forward 4D Tracking
abstract: arXiv:2609.32596v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Feed-forward models regress dense 3D point trajectories directly from monocular video, yet the residual after global alignment is substantial and lacks a structural explanation. Measured on dynamic query points across models and datasets, the error concentrates along the view direction, while the scale correction each motion group requires differs. The predicted displacement direction nevertheless supports reliable grouping, with a median angle far below the 90{\deg} random baseline. The systematic part of the residual is therefore a family of radial degrees of freedom per motion group, along directions 2D observations cannot constrain. We call it group-wise view inconsistency. We present GAUGE (Group-wise Adaptive Unsupervised Gauge Estimation), a training-free and model-agnostic post-hoc module. It recovers motion groups from direction consistency and spatial connectivity, then estimates a per-frame radial scale and group-lev

translated_title: GAUGE：面向前馈式4D跟踪的组级视点不一致性校正
translated_abstract: 前馈模型直接从单目视频中回归稠密的3D点轨迹，然而全局对齐后的残差仍然很大，且缺乏结构性的解释。在不同模型和数据集的动态查询点上的测量表明，误差集中在视线方向上，而每个运动组所需的尺度校正各不相同。尽管如此，预测的位移方向仍支持可靠的分组，其中位角远低于90°的随机基线。因此，残差的系统性部分对应于每个运动组的一族径向自由度，其方向无法被2D观测所约束。我们将其称为组级视点不一致性。我们提出了GAUGE（Group-wise Adaptive Unsupervised Gauge Estimation，组级自适应无监督规范估计），这是一个无需训练、与模型无关的事后处理模块。它通过方向一致性和空间连通性恢复运动组，然后估计每帧的径向尺度和组级（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 本文提出GAUGE，一个无需训练、与模型无关的事后处理模块，通过从位移方向一致性恢复运动组并估计每帧径向尺度，来校正前馈式4D跟踪中沿视线方向的组级不一致性误差。
en_tdlr: GAUGE is a training-free, model-agnostic post-hoc module that rectifies group-wise view inconsistency in feed-forward 4D tracking by recovering motion groups from displacement direction consistency and estimating per-frame radial scales to correct errors concentrated along the view direction.
